nom: Pacifica Bacne Warrior - Bacne Salicylic Acid Spray

avis.titre: Must try if you have back acne!Must try if you have back acne!
avis.texte: I had serious back acne a few months ago. And I had tried everything people recommended and swear by but nothing helped. I needed something to work quickly because I had a photo shoot coming up so I picked this up and WOW!!! It works FAST! Within just a few weeks (like two?) my back acne was clearing up! I’ve repurchased this product like 4 times since then because my back is fully clear and I feel comfortable wearing tank tops again! For me, a can lasts up to around 2 months with everyday use so I’d say it’s 100% worth the price since it really does work great. Application is simple, since my back acne is typically on the back of my shoulders I like to just spray the product on my hands and rub it in if I don’t have someone around to help. But when I do spray it directly on my back it’s not too difficult because the mist is super fine. I will say, the smell is STRONG and kind of burns the nostrils, so I recommend spraying it and walking away. Definitely don’t let that stop you from trying this though if you have back acne.

I bought this product by accident but decided to keep it because I battle acne on my chest every fall and winter. The product itself gets 5 stars. If used early, it cleared up any break-outs overnight! Truly amazing. The packaging, however, ZERO stars. The spray mechanism was so hard to push down and control that I had to spray it into my other hand, and then rub it where I wanted it. Now, after only a few uses, it down doesn't work at all, so I am going to have to throw out 90% or the product. Very disappointing, and i hope the manufacturer reads these reviews and fixes their design.

avis.titre: Yes yes, you should buy this
avis.texte: I’d give this 500 stars if I could. Where has this been my whole life? I’ve had body acne since adolescence, and the only thing it’s ever responded to is prescription creams (which are expensive for how much coverage you need and also difficult to apply to oneself.) I’ve tried salicylic acid based body washes before, but they just end up drying out my skin until I have to discontinue them (and the body acne comes back) or I have to use so much moisturizer that the acne doesn’t go away. But this stuff? Downright magic. I towel dry after a shower, step back into the shower, and quickly spray myself with ease. My skin has improved so much without cracking or drying out. I wish I had a Time Machine to take a case of this stuff to my high school self. (A heads up, this stuff is very unpleasant to breathe in. I hold my breath during application in the shower, and then immediately step out of the shower stall before I breathe again.)

I use this product after I shower. I also use the Panoxyl Benzoyl peroxide cleanser in my back in the shower to kill the bacteria and fight inflammation. Paired with this bacne spray has really helped my skin stay clear and heal acne a lot quicker. A little goes a long way! It’s very light weight and absorbs quickly. It’s not greasy at all. The only thing is, it does make me cough so I have to spray while in the shower and then come out, otherwise I keep coughing lol It’s a great size and I love the fine mist spray - it allows for a light layer, and easy to spray more if needed. The fine mist also sprays far enough down my back so it’s very easy to reach lower back. Great effective product!

I rarely write reviews but felt the need for this one. I just repurchased on sale because it was working amazingly for butt acne... And I've also been using it on my bikini area for ingrown and it has worked so well compared to everything else I've tried over the years for those areas. I was inspired to write the review because I finally put some on a facial area where I've been having hormonal acne that hasn't seemed to go away for the past few months. I think it started out as hormonal acne and then maybe turn into tiny ingrown hair bumps from plucking too often or messing with that area and I finally got inspired to put some of this on an exfoliating cotton pad last night. And I woke up and the bumps were gone! This stuff is magic. I wouldn't recommend putting it all over your face but only using it as a spot treatment from time to time. And this spray is so convenient for the back area. Add to that, it smells amazing. I paid way more money the first time and I was about to be grudgingly shell out more and was so pleasantly surprised to find it on sale. Buy this! It's a worthy investment that you won't regret.

My 14 yo used to use this regularly. She says it works well and does help with the acne on her back. The only thing she does not like is the fact that the can does not spray upside down. She uses the dermatologic one and it does spray upside down. This unfortunately is a make or break for her. But the formula itself works well

I honestly wasn't expecting this to work. At least not as well and as quickly as it did. Thanks to my best friend peri, I have back acne. I gave this a shot hoping that spraying it would help due to the location. Yes!!! Sprayer is strong. Smell is also slightly strong but goes away quickly. Not greasy. My acne has decreased greatly in less than a week of using nightly. Will recommend to anyone!

Literally life changing. I've struggled and struggled for the better part of 15 years with acne on my back from normal imbalances. It's been at its worst this year. This product made a significant difference within days of using it. The smell is tough, I spray it in the bathroom while holding my breath and then walk out. I can finally wear tank tops again.

I have been struggling with acne for years. I use salicylic acid body wash but that wasn’t cutting it, I needed to add a spray. I used a different brands spray but it was over priced and hard to reach my back. This spray has been so helpful in keeping back breakouts away for a fraction of the cost. The can also makes it super easy to spray on your back and tough to reach spots. Make sure you do this in a ventilated space though because if you spray and inhale any of it then it will make you cough.

This spray has worked really well for my teens! I have 3 teenagers using it, and they all like how easy it is to apply, especially for back and body acne. We started noticing improvement after consistent use, and it doesn’t feel sticky or harsh on their skin. The price is great too, especially when it’s on sale. Definitely a product we keep repurchasing in our house!

avis.titre: This stuff is my new best friend!
avis.texte: Didn't have high hopes at first, but this stuff works AMAZINGLY!!! It can very slightly sting if you've been picking (like I tend to do 😅), but it's nothing unbearable by any means. I definitely recommend it! 😁

Great! This helped me so much with ny acne break out on the back. It will hurt a but at first, but it gets mire comfortable once your bigger pimples clear. Use this with an antibacterial soap. Skin can get dry so moisturize a lot. Cover your nose with you spray it. Very effective!

Es buenísimo en una semana vi resultados muy buenos , te seca los granitos enseguida y no se siente para nada pesado en la piel 9/10 , lo único que no me gusta mucho es que el olor es un poco fuerte cuando te lo hechas ya luego no lo sientes pero si es bien efectivo

avis.titre: Not the same volume as advertised
avis.texte: Packaging is different ( which has no impact on the product ) but the volume stated was 6 FL OZ and what I was sent was 5.8 FL OZ. May not be an issue to most but I specifically picked this product for the volume.

avis.titre: Noticed Size discrepancy but love the product
avis.texte: Size discrepancy. 6oz and the other is labeled 5.8oz. But I love the product, more than its competitors.

avis.titre: Can t really say if it s work
avis.texte: After spraying my back four times with they spray it was done. I can t understand how a spray bottle finished after four times uses. Especially when using it only on my upper back

It has a new packaging design (blue) and I compared the volumes. The old bottle is 177ml and the new one is 172ml. Now it might seem like it's not much but that's what most companies want you to think so they can continue to gradually give us less product for the same price. Take what you will with this information. I still like the product but I don't plan on purchasing this again.

The smell wasn’t bad for me and it liked how easy it was to apply. I don’t have super sensitive skin and have used all sorts of products on my chest but this product has given me a sunburn type rash all over my chest. I’m giving it 2 stars bc it could be a really cool product but just didn’t work on my skin.
